title: pure chaotic joy @Club NVRLND 🧚 #clubNVRLND #fringetheatre #immersive...
transcript: I'm at Edinburgh Fringe and I just got out of Club NVRLND and I just have to say that was one of the best immersive club shows I've ever seen very loose premise is that it is Peter Pan's birthday and we're at his club and we're there to celebrate but Peter Pan is not ready to grow up all the music is like 2000s covers panic at the disco and Avril Lavigne and Kelly Clarkson it is so much fun I'll put a couple clips here what works so well is that it's an entirely like immersive experience where everyone knows all of the characters you know Peter you know hook you know Wendy you know Tiger Lily every time they introduce someone you are aware of who they are and you know all the music and so they encourage you to sing along you're allowed to film you're allowed to dance it just is a big party and it's so effective and it is the best way to like finish a night I went with a big group of friends we were having so much fun I just could not recommend it more if you are in Edinburgh this month go see Club Neverland I am so happy
